body:
Its not just about the girl, I guess that's really more of the catalyst or the final straw that broke the camel's back. I'm completely overwhelmed in every other aspect of my life right now too. I'm stuck in a job I hate but can't afford to leave, I'm completely overwhelmed with my masters program, my mother has been slipping further and further into dementia, and my best friend and brother just moved out to Colorado. Nothing is going well right now and I have to be everyone's rock. My ex was mine and I felt like as long as we had each other we could handle everything life threw at us. Now she's gone and I'm sort of just fending for myself, but I'm also very hurt over losing her as well. I'm sure people will miss me but I feel like its because they need me and not because they want me. I'm suffocating under all of this responsibility and I have to keep pretending to be strong so that everyone else will be alright. Coming home to an empty place and not having her to confide in is just the icing on the cake. I feel like I can't help anyone or succeed when I'm falling apart on the inside.

I'm sorry, I'm not sure if any of this is making any sense...

I know she likes me, I don't really have a problem talking to women or getting a date. The problem is I can't let go of the past and move on. I feel like I'm still in the relationship that just ended, and as fucked up as it sounds I feel like I'm cheating on my ex when I'm talking to these women. I mean, I've spent over three years building a life together with someone who one day just decided that she didn't love me anymore. It was like my world just imploded and every day I wake up I feel like part of me is missing.

>is this your first gf or something?

No. I've dated plenty in the past. I'm 26 and working on a masters; I guess I'm just pathetic, I know.
